# Supplement Facts Check

> An independent, open-data audit of dose disclosure on gut-health supplement labels. Six binary criteria, 0-6 scale. Methodology v1.7, locked 2026-09-07. Pilot stage: 3 products scored. Authored by Ryan Pepple, who owns a competing brand (CalmGut, operating as SHUVEN); author-owned products are scored separately and never ranked.

## Pilot scores

- Physician's CHOICE Probiotics 60 Billion CFU (Physician's Choice): 2/6, label captured 2026-09-07
- BIOMA Probiotics (BIOMA): 1/6, label captured 2026-09-07
- Seed DS-01 Daily Synbiotic (Seed): 2/6, label captured 2026-09-07

## Data
